Exercise 4

A)


```{r ex4}

# initialise
set.seed(333)
c <- 1
phi <- 0.5
sample <- 100
n <- 1000
q <- 1

# values needed for tests
c0 <- 1
crit <- qnorm(0.975)
m <- floor(4*((sample/100)^(2/9)))

# initialise counters
counter11 <- 0
counter21 <- 0
counter31 <- 0

# run for loop to calculate the s^2 values
for (i in 1:n) {
  # calculate our function terms
  e <- rnorm(sample+1, 0, 1)
  y <- c + e[2:(sample+1)] + phi*e[1:sample]
  c_hat <- mean(y)
  
  # now we want to calculate our s^2 values
  s21 <- mean((y - c_hat)^2)
  
  # lag order 1 so q is 1

  }
  s22 <- 0
  s23 <- 0
}
```
